adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `Discourse.Group.findMembers` clamps `offset` using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` before the AJAX call (`offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`). After `removeMember` it calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. Scenario: 51 users, page 2 has `offset=50`; after removal total becomes 50 but the refetch still requests `offset=50`, so `GroupsController#members` (`limit/offset` applied directly) returns an empty `members` array. UI will still show page 2 because `currentPage` is derived from `offset`, and `totalPages` is also incorrect (`Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1` yields 2 when `user_count==limit`). This can strand the admin on an empty last page.
